What doesn't work Oscar?  The screen shots you sent do not indicate there is a problem.


On 13/06/2018 10:47, Oscar Dewhurst wrote:
Hi all,

I'm currently having issues installing the mrds and Distance packages in R from GitHub. I need to get them from GitHub as I need the latest versions of them. I'm using the following lines of code:

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("DistanceDevelopment/mrds")
devtools::install_github("DistanceDevelopment/Distance")

Unfortunately neither is working. I've also tried installing them on my Apple laptop as well as a desktop PC, and I get the same issue. I have attached images that show the output when trying to install each package.

Any ideas for what might be causing this? I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling R and R studio, etc., so am at a bit of a loss.

Thanks in advance,

Oscar

parts:
Hi Oscar,

I had got a similar issue while loading both mrds and distance packages.
Its an issue of order of loading the packages as some functions in Distance (esp "ds") is masked by mrds. I would suggest you look into re-ordering the packages while loading.

I loaded package "Distance" before loading "mrds" in R console
i did not need to install "devtools" for it.

I hope this is helpful.
All the best!!
